name: pivot_having_over_prices_table
query: SELECT currency, year(date) AS y, max(number(amount)) AS high FROM #prices WHERE currency ~ '^V' GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING count(*) > 40 PIVOT BY currency, y
notes: PIVOT BY combined with FROM #prices and HAVING. 2017 has only 36 weekly prices per commodity, so HAVING drops those groups and no '2017' column is produced: the columns come from the rows left after HAVING.
